name: NCAA D-I Mountain Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: Mountain Regional: No. 1 New Mexico, No. 2 Colorado and No. 1 BYU
summary: The toughest region in the country, with only two automatic team bids. The men’s race has No. 1 New Mexico, No. 2 Colorado, No. 6 BYU and No. 20 Northern Arizona; the women’s race has No. 1 BYU, No. 6 Northern Arizona, No. 7 New Mexico, No. 9 Colorado and No. 16 Utah. Women run 6K at 11:00 a.m. MT and men 10K at noon.
